subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Equifax Exposes America
description: A 60-second lesson on Equifax Exposes America.

hook.text: In 2017, hackers stole Social Security numbers, birth dates, and addresses of 147 million Americans.

buildup.text: Equifax, a credit reporting agency, held sensitive data on most American adults — and failed to protect it.

discovery.text: The breach happened through an unpatched software vulnerability that Equifax knew about for months.

twist.text: Equifax executives sold $2 million in stock before the breach was announced publicly.

climax.text: A company you never chose collected your data, lost it, and profited while you suffered the consequences.

punchline.text: They had your data. They lost it. You paid the price.

quiz.question: How did the Equifax breach happen?
options: Through an unpatched software vulnerability known for months
Through a phishing email to the CEO
Through a physical break-in at their offices
